title: The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Leonis Death Magnus, the undead Dark Lord who sealed himself away a thousand years ago, awakens in the body of a ten-year-old boy. Riselia, the girl who found his tomb, dies shielding him from a monstrous Void, and he revives her as a vampire queen; she then takes him in as her ward at a military academy. Leonis hides his power while investigating the changed world and pursuing the mission given him by the Goddess of Rebellion. The ten-volume manga adapts the light novels.
life_message: Bonds formed with those who care for you can matter more than an old mission of conquest.
